{{Quote|I can kill at least one of you before you can reach me, and the Sentry droids up the cliffs could do some damage to the rest of you, so don't make any sudden moves and listen to my offer.|Clargod, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Strike III">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Strike III}}</ref>}}
'''Clargod''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Clargod and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Dee'Hars]], [[Kelyan]] and [[Kiimo]] traveled to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], planning to capture [[Mattenic]] and [[Kerkum]], two former [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] of the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]. Clargod and the rest of the team claimed to be in the employ of the [[Office of Peace and Security]], a law enforcement body that had placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Mattenic and Kerkum. However, they were also working for [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who had recently seized control of crime in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] from Nirama, and the bounty hunters planned to get paid twice for capturing the pair. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were also looking for Mattenic and Kerkum, and they prevented Clargod and the other bounty hunters from capturing the pair.<ref name="Preemptive Strike" />

A short time afterward, the Heroes of Cularin destroyed Riboga's [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on the planet [[Kemix]],<ref name="Counterstrike">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Counterstrike}}</ref> so the Hutt hired Clargod, Dee'Hars, Kelyan and Kiimo to bring the heroes into a state of despair, and then [[Death/Legends|kill]] them. The bounty hunters placed explosives aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that the heroes were traveling on and then detonated the devices, bringing the hero's craft out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and causing it to crash on the planet [[Holador]]. The bounty hunters landed on the world and Clargod took up a position in a valley, with some [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]] that were under her command. The heroes eventually made their way into the valley and Clargod offered to make a deal with them, whereby she would fight them all individually in unarmed combat, rather than simply attacking them all at the same time. The heroes engaged her in combat and defeated her, and they eventually made it off Holador.<ref name="Strike III" />
